Q441.reason: Evidence of liability insurance is generally inadmissible to prove negligence or ownership, but may be admissible for other purposes such as impeachment; here, it is least likely admissible because it is offered to show ownership, which is not a permissible purpose.

Q442.reason: The energy charge of the cell refers to the extent to which the total adenine nucleotide pool is phosphorylated, defined as ([ATP] + 0.5[ADP]) / ([ATP] + [ADP] + [AMP]).
